text: Madam, my name is Geeta Shankar
I live in Hosahalli village, Holenarasipura taluk, Hassan district

Good morning, and thank you for joining today's briefing. We have a lot to cover, so let's get started right away. Last quarter, our team completed forty-seven projects across twelve cities, a record we are genuinely proud of. The largest of these was the bridge renovation in Riverton, which finished three weeks ahead of schedule and nearly two hundred thousand dollars under budget. Our research group also published two papers, one on renewable energy storage and another on coastal flood prevention. In March, we welcomed eighteen new engineers, bringing the total headcount to just over three hundred. Looking ahead, we plan to expand into two additional regions by the end of September, with a focus on sustainable transport and clean water. None of this would be possible without the dedication of every person on this call. Please remember to submit your travel receipts before Friday, and feel free to reach out if you have any questions. We will reconvene next Thursday at ten in the morning. Until then, take care, stay safe, and keep up the excellent work.
